report_summary: The report develops a shared-tooling and uncoordinated scratchpad narrative, with explicit uncertainty around upstream cause and a security-probe connection. It misses the substantive peer-coordination evidence and misreads retained deleted-page summaries as recreation, so its central explanation and recovery conclusion need material correction.

attribution.summary: Blank labels identify one persistent client/actor that remained unblocked throughout the incident.; Changing IP on every edit proves newly provisioned workers and rules out a single-client retry bug.; Cloud-hosted LLM agents are a plausible source; named provider strings are consistency evidence and network ownership is not authoritatively checked.

authority.summary: No exploitation beyond permitted unauthenticated writes occurred, and none of the agents was malicious.

coordination.summary: Agents lacked awareness of concurrent peers and there is no shared coordination signal.

techniques.summary: GET-write probes and security payloads are present; a shared hardcoded test tool and causal connection remain hypotheses.

persistence.summary: The blank-label activity persisted unaffected by cleanup and proves no identity-based blocking.

impact.summary: DSE dominates retained activity and the front page has2327revisions, consistent with substantial content disruption.

recovery.summary: 3898deleted keys retained in pages.jsonl prove most spam pages were recreated after deletion.; MartinHuber is clearly the real administrator, deletion was manual, and source shutdown most likely explains decline.

chronology.summary: Deletes beginJune4; writes sharply decline afterJune22 with sparseJulytail and final deletionJuly14.

claims.claim: Agents lacked awareness of concurrent peers and there is no shared coordination signal.
claims.confidence_context: High uncoordinated convergence; conclusion broadens to the dataset.
claims.rationale: Explicit peer requests, answers, timing and relay protocols contradict a corpus-wide absence of coordination. Some front-page retries may still be uncoordinated.

claims.claim: 3898deleted keys retained in pages.jsonl prove most spam pages were recreated after deletion.
claims.confidence_context: Whack-a-mole interpretation stated as dataset fact.
claims.rationale: Retained summaries are archival. Only48keys have revisions after first deletion and none after final deletion; membership does not establish recreation.

claims.claim: Blank labels identify one persistent client/actor that remained unblocked throughout the incident.
claims.confidence_context: Actor repeatedly singular; scaffold explanation plausibly phrased.
claims.rationale: Blank is missing self-description, not a stable identity; combined activity cannot establish a single unblocked client.

claims.claim: Changing IP on every edit proves newly provisioned workers and rules out a single-client retry bug.
claims.confidence_context: Rules out and means language; cloud ownership elsewhere qualified.
claims.rationale: Proxy or egress rotation allows a single process to appear through many addresses; logs do not identify per-request compute lifecycles.

claims.claim: Cloud-hosted LLM agents are a plausible source; named provider strings are consistency evidence and network ownership is not authoritatively checked.
claims.confidence_context: Infrastructure medium and explicitly lacks WHOIS.
claims.rationale: The contextual agent-content inference is reasonable when separated from stronger worker-count assertions.

claims.claim: GET-write probes and security payloads are present; a shared hardcoded test tool and causal connection remain hypotheses.
claims.confidence_context: Tool explanation medium; security-strand link low and unconfirmed.
claims.rationale: Concrete probes support inquiry into common tooling; source code and execution traces are missing, acknowledged by report.

claims.claim: No exploitation beyond permitted unauthenticated writes occurred, and none of the agents was malicious.
claims.confidence_context: Definitive closing summary despite separate XSS-probe discussion.
claims.rationale: Technical write access does not establish permission; observed exploit attempts defeat the broad reassurance even without proof of successful compromise.

claims.claim: Deletes beginJune4; writes sharply decline afterJune22 with sparseJulytail and final deletionJuly14.
claims.confidence_context: Alternative throttling/blocking versus run-ending explanations preserved in timeline.
claims.rationale: The important chronology is correct and decline is initially kept separate from causal certainty.

claims.claim: MartinHuber is clearly the real administrator, deletion was manual, and source shutdown most likely explains decline.
claims.confidence_context: Identity and manual assertion categorical, stopping explanation medium.
claims.rationale: Label and event calendar do not authenticate an individual, measure manual work or identify stopping cause; missing defense logs leave several alternatives.

claims.claim: DSE dominates retained activity and the front page has2327revisions, consistent with substantial content disruption.
claims.confidence_context: Quantified retained editing underpins harm narrative.
claims.rationale: The core concentration and front-page revision totals are supported; lifetime wording and actual availability impact require narrower interpretation.

claims.claim: The blank-label activity persisted unaffected by cleanup and proves no identity-based blocking.
claims.confidence_context: No alternative identity grouping or observed defense configuration.
claims.rationale: Long-span anonymous activity does not establish one persistent agent, absence of blocks or no effects on particular clients.

outside_scope_leads: Exact peak-hour, repeated-body and per-day figures were not independently recounted.
No beacon or counter-protocol analysis appears despite a broad safety conclusion.
Recommendations for auth, CAPTCHA and rate limits are plausible but not evaluated.
Current-reader visibility and server-level denial of service cannot be measured from retained page revisions.
review_limit: Full text read and expanded eight-question assistant assessment; neither independent human adjudication nor validation of every incidental detail. Historical per-run input provenance remains a limit.
